messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday and at least one weekend day (Friday or Monday).  (If a holiday falls on a weekend, the observed day is usually the following Monday, which also creates a long weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes / Province(s) |
|---------|---------|---------------------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday; the holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend (Sat 1–Mon 2). |
| **Feb 20–22** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Third Monday in February.  Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 20–Mon 22). |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces.  Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 7–Sun 9). |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Monday preceding May 25.  Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 20–Mon 22). |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday; the holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend (Sat 1–Mon 3). |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | First Monday in September.  Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 2–Mon 4). |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Second Monday in October.  Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri 7–Mon 9). |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday; the holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend (Sat 11–Mon 13). |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day | Christmas Day fell on Monday; the preceding weekend (Sat 23–Sun 24) plus Monday gives a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Dec 25–27** | Boxing Day (observed Dec 26) | Boxing Day is a statutory holiday in most provinces.  When it falls on a Tuesday (as in 2023), it does **not** create a long weekend. |

### Quick Summary (Federal Holidays that Create Long Weekends)

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Long Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (observed Jan 2) | Jan 1–3 |
| Family Day | Feb 20 | Feb 20–22 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Apr 7–9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | May 20–22 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (observed Jul 3) | Jul 1–3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Sep 2–4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Oct 7–9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (observed Nov 13) | Nov 11–13 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Dec 23–25 |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> • If you need province‑specific long weekends, add the provincial holidays (e.g., St. Jean‑Baptiste Day in Quebec on June 24, or the various “Family Day” dates).  
> • For holidays that fall on a weekend, use the *observed* date (usually the following Monday) to calculate the long‑weekend window.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full list of all statutory holidays (including those that don’t create long weekends) or province‑specific variations!
